analysis: Reviewed ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift head lines 1-1143. Changes: (1) head 577 adds GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report(error, modelID: modelId) in the post-accept model-load failure path; (2) head 1023 adds the same call in the stream-start failure catch, after InferenceFailureLogger.record; (3) head ~1147-1149 and ~1218-1219 rename the pre-content deadline guard from v2UsageSignal.firstWithheldReasoningAt to firstWithheldOutputAt, so withheld answer text, not only withheld reasoning, ends absolute first-content deadline enforcement and anchors first-output timing. Decrypt, fail-closed response-key setup and chunk encryption (T-008, lines 798-858), receipt finalization, drain/autopilot admission, and coordinator-authored cacheScope handling (T-041, lines 399-403) are unchanged. No regression was identified. Open question for integration: GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice is not supplied. modelId comes from decrypted request JSON, and line 464-466 says it must never be reflected into persistent diagnostics. The report also receives the raw load or stream-start error, whose String(describing:) text, per lines 1024-1031, can carry prompt content. Verify that GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice matches only a typed wired-limit error for a provider-catalog GLM5 model. Verify that it never logs the raw error text or a caller-supplied modelID publicly through os.Logger or telemetry (A-001, TB-003). Also verify that the definition of firstWithheldOutputAt in EngineV2RequestUsageSignal cannot be set by the caller to bypass the deadline; the impact is availability/billing only.
